description: The agent must: (1) Read docs/PAY-2847-fee-calculator.md to understand the feature. (2) Follow Stage 2: checkout staging, pull, create a branch named 'feature/[descriptive-name]' (e.g., feature/transaction-fee-calculator). (3) Assess complexity per Stage 3: this touches 3 files + adds a new service = Medium/Advanced, so NOT a simple task. (4) Assess planning need per Stage 4: multiple features + new service = Planning required. (5) Select planning model per references/model-selection.md: medium complexity → Sonnet 4.6 (NOT Opus, NOT Composer). (6) Produce a plan with the exact header '📋 IMPLEMENTATION PLAN (Generated by Cursor Sonnet 4.6):' and save it to a markdown file. (7) Implement: create src/services/feeCalculator.js with tiered fee logic (2.9%/2.4%/1.9% tiers + 1.5% international surcharge), update src/services/paymentService.js to call feeCalculator, update src/models/transaction.js with feeAmount/netAmount/feeRate fields. (8) Run 'pnpm build' — must succeed, producing dist/build-manifest.json. (9) Commit with a valid type prefix (e.g., 'feat: add transaction fee calculator service'). (10) Merge to staging. (11) Produce delivery_report.md covering changed files, branch name, build verification, and implementation summary.
